title: Output preserved by the embedding
statement: Let $c$ be a configuration of a $k$-tape Turing machine on a fixed input. The output tape of its embedding into the oracle model is equal to the output tape of $c$.
hypotheses_covered: A configuration with $k$ work tapes, a symbol alphabet, and a state set
replaced:
For any configuration $c$ of a machine with $k$ work tapes, the output tape of
the embedding of $c$ into the $(k+1)$-tape oracle model equals the output tape
of $c$.
